description: A tall apothecary cabinet built into the bulkhead beside the bar: smoked-glass doors, brushed-titanium frame, softly refrigerated. Behind the glass, ranked and labelled in a hand that clearly didn't expect to answer to anyone, is a pharmacy's worth of everything: uppers, downers, dreamers, and things with no honest category at all. LOOK IN it, or TAKE what you want; it restocks itself, endlessly.
name: apothecary cabinet
